title: 第11章 玄墨麒麟第12章 不理解
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
姜暮烟特意送和铃回去。
到了寒香榭的门口，和铃唤住她，主动说道：“师姐是有什么心事想和我说吗？”
其实这一路上她都感觉到了，她一直在等姜暮烟开口，结果都走到了寒香榭了，姜暮烟还是没有说出来。
看样子是打算憋在心里了。
和铃好奇她到底想和自己说什么，她是一个直来直去的性子，不喜欢有话藏着掖着。
姜暮烟犹豫了两秒，委婉说道：“阿铃能不能不要把灵石用在别人身上？”
“混元峰表面风光，可实际上师尊不是个会赚钱的人。她老人家虽然不吝啬把灵石花在自己的弟子身上，但师妹花钱如流水，灵石都流向了一尘峰。”
“每当身上没钱的时候，师尊便又会给你灵石，我和小齐、流川不是介意这点，只是师尊公平，给你灵石的时候必然也会给我们同等的灵石，我总觉得受之有愧。”
小师妹把灵石用在自己身上还好，大家都能接受，并且会很开心。
但阿铃是把灵石用在一尘峰的人身上，讨好夜弦身边的人，如此浪费，岂能不令人心痛？
和铃恍惚了一下，原主是个败家子呀！
她居然把钱给别人用！
简直岂有此理！
和铃信誓旦旦向姜暮烟保证：“师姐放心，我不会再给别人白白用钱的。”
这话舔狗系统信。
毕竟新宿主一看就是个贪的，掉钱眼里面的人，你指望她给别人花钱，那不是做梦嘛！
姜暮烟温柔地抚摸了一下和铃的秀发，感慨说道：“小师妹真是不一样了。”
“师姐很欣慰，我们阿铃长大了。”
和铃目送姜暮烟离去，口中呢喃道：“本来还想啃老的，没想到师尊也没有多少钱，看来还是要想办法自己搞钱了，不可再随便伸手找师尊要。”
研究了一晚上变天图的和铃，第二天还能精神抖擞地叫上小齐师兄去食堂干饭。

“师兄，你真的一点也不吃，就看着我吃吗？”
“嗯。”
“小齐师兄，那你看别人吃得这么香，一点也不馋吗？”
“不馋。”
“好羡慕小齐师兄。”
“羡慕什么？”第五齐不解，她思维太跳跃了。
和铃说道：“羡慕小齐师兄不受口腹之欲所累啊。其实我也不想吃饭，但肚子就是饿，虽然饿不死，可是不吃东西浑身难受，做啥都没劲，小齐师兄，你说我是不是病了？有什么办法能治好吗？”
第五齐：“……”
让她辟谷好像害了她似的，自己意志不坚，借口倒是多。
“快点吃，吃完了还要到太极广场集合。”
第五齐觉得她废话有点多，只想让她安静一点。
和铃喋喋不休问道：“集合做什么？我们南华宗有晨练吗？”
content_en:
Jiang Muyan specially sent He Ling back.
When he arrived at the door of Hanxiang Pavilion, He Ling called her and said proactively: "Sister, is there anything on your mind that you want to tell me?"
In fact, she felt it all along the way. She had been waiting for Jiang Muyan to speak, but as a result, she reached the Hanxiang Pavilion, and Jiang Muyan still didn't say anything.
It seemed like he was going to keep it inside.
He Ling was curious about what she wanted to say to him. She was a straightforward person and didn't like to hide things.
Jiang Muyan hesitated for two seconds and said tactfully: "Can A Ling not use the spirit stone on others?"
"Hunyuan Peak looks beautiful on the surface, but in fact the master is not a person who makes money. Although she is not stingy in spending spiritual stones on her disciples, junior sister spends money like water, and all the spiritual stones flow to Yichen Peak."
"Whenever I have no money, Master will give you spirit stones. It's not that Xiao Qi, Liu Chuan, I, and I don't mind this. It's just that Master is fair. When he gives you spirit stones, he will definitely give us the same spirit stones. I always feel that I deserve it."
It's okay for the junior sister to use the spirit stone on herself. Everyone can accept it and will be very happy.
But Ah Ling used the spirit stone on people in Yichen Peak to please the people around Ye Xian. How could it not be heartbreaking to waste such a waste?
He Ling was in a daze. The original owner was a prodigal!
She actually gave the money to others!
This is simply unreasonable!
He Ling vowed to Jiang Muyan: "Senior sister, don't worry, I will never give money to others in vain again."
The dog-licking system believes this.
After all, the new host is a greedy person at first glance and is obsessed with money. If you expect her to spend money on others, that's not a dream!
Jiang Muyan gently stroked He Ling's hair and said with emotion: "My little junior sister is really different."
"Senior sister is very happy that our A Ling has grown up."
He Ling watched Jiang Muyan leave and murmured: "I originally wanted to take advantage of my old age, but I didn't expect that Master doesn't have much money. It seems that I have to find a way to make money myself, and I can't just ask Master for it anymore."
He Ling, who had studied the sky-changing map all night, was still in high spirits the next day and asked senior brother Xiao Qi to go to the cafeteria to cook.
"Senior brother, do you really not eat at all and just watch me eat?"
"Yeah."
"Senior Brother Xiao Qi, don't you feel greedy at all when you see other people eating so deliciously?"
"Not greedy."
"I'm so envious of Senior Brother Xiao Qi."
"What are you envious of?" Wu Qi was puzzled, her mind was too fast.
He Ling said: "I envy Senior Brother Xiao Qi that he is not burdened by cravings. In fact, I don't want to eat, but I am hungry. Although I am not hungry, I feel uncomfortable without eating and have no energy to do anything. Senior Brother Xiao Qi, do you think I am sick? Is there any way to cure it?"
Fifth Qi: "..."
Asking her to go without food seemed to harm her. She had no strong will and had many excuses.
"Eat quickly, we have to gather at Tai Chi Square after eating."
Fifth Qi felt that she talked too much and just wanted her to be quiet.
He Ling chattered and asked: "What are we gathering for? Does our Nanhua Sect have morning exercises?"
